header.title: Activate your payouts with Stripe
header.subtitle: To receive money from your sales, you need to complete your secure registration on Stripe Connect. It's free and usually takes a few minutes.

guidance.tip1_desc: Have your ID ready. Stripe may ask for photos to securely verify your <resaltar>identity</resaltar>.
guidance.accountType_desc: If Stripe asks for your account type, choose the option that matches your tax situation, such as individual or business, when applicable.
guidance.tip2_desc: If Stripe asks for your account type or business category, choose the option that best describes your activity. For hardware sales, it may appear as <resaltar>electronics, computing, or other merchandise</resaltar>.
guidance.tip3_title: Have your CLABE bank account ready
guidance.tip3_desc: You will need to input your 18-digit CLABE so Stripe can send earnings according to your payout configuration and availability.
guidance.ready_desc: You're ready. When you tap below, the secure Stripe Connect browser flow will open. After completing registration, you will return to Selene.

status.pending: In progress — complete the remaining steps
status.rejected: Stripe rejected your information — check your account
status.rejectedTitle: Stripe needs to review your information
status.rejectedDesc: Open Stripe to see which details are missing or which documents need correction.

statusGuidance.newDesc: Open Stripe's secure flow to create your seller payout account. You can return to Selene after registration.
statusGuidance.pendingTitle: Stripe needs a little more information
statusGuidance.pendingDesc: Your account is in progress. Continue in Stripe to finish any remaining steps or wait while Stripe reviews your details.
statusGuidance.rejectedDesc: Stripe needs corrected details or documents. Open Stripe to review the request and submit the missing information.

success.title: All set to sell!
success.subtitle: Your Stripe Connect account is active and securely configured. You can now print shipping labels and receive payouts according to your deposit schedule.

loading.title: Checking your Stripe status
loading.subtitle: We're confirming whether you can already receive payments before showing the steps.

errors.statusUnavailable: We couldn't check your Stripe status. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.refreshFailed: We couldn't refresh your Stripe status. Showing the saved information.
errors.onboardingUrlUnavailable: Stripe did not return a registration link. Try again.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

steps.typeDesc: If Stripe asks for your account type, choose the option that matches your tax situation.
steps.detailsDesc: Complete Stripe's fields with accurate information and choose the category that best represents your products.
steps.doneDesc: The secure Stripe Connect browser flow will open so you can continue registration.
